title: Orthonormal partner of a unit vector in a 2-plane
statement: For every P ∈ ℕ, every linear subspace Q ⊆ ℝ^P (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) with dim Q = 2 and every u ∈ Q with ‖u‖ = 1, there is e ∈ Q with ‖e‖ = 1 and ⟨u, e⟩ = 0 such that every v ∈ Q satisfies v = ⟨v, u⟩u + ⟨v, e⟩e.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (u : Euclid P), Module.finrank ℝ Q = 2 → u ∈ Q → ‖u‖ = 1 → ∃ e : Euclid P, e ∈ Q ∧ ‖e‖ = 1 ∧ inner ℝ u e = 0 ∧ ∀ v ∈ Q, v = inner ℝ v u • u + inner ℝ v e • e
